prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: shippable high-fidelity desktop web-app concept, 1536×960 landscape
Primary request: Design the ASC Studio “Overview” screen as an Operations Matrix for the selected app. This is a production product UI composition, not concept art and not a generic SaaS dashboard.
Input images: Image 1 is the exact dark ASC Studio sidebar palette and navigation reference; preserve its dark chrome, icons, active-state treatment, proportions, and typography. Images 2 and 3 are full-screen ASC Studio references for density, spacing, flat surfaces, thin dividers, tables, topbar scale, and component character; translate them into dark mode but do not reuse their page content or layout.
Structure: Keep the fixed 276px ASC Studio sidebar at left with “Overview” active, app selector “Orbit Notes / com.example.orbitnotes”, the full navigation, and “Apple services · Demo” at bottom. The content begins with a 121px header: “Overview”, subtitle “The selected app at a glance.”, and a restrained “Sync” button. Directly below, include the real pale-amber dark-mode “Demo mode” banner.
Main composition: an asymmetric four-lane operations matrix that fills the remaining viewport with no scrolling. A wide Release lane occupies the upper-left and shows “Release 2.5.0”, “Prepare for submission”, platform iOS, build candidate 211, six locales, and a clear “Open release” action. A narrower TestFlight lane at upper-right shows latest build 211, Ready, Internal, one tester group, uploaded 12 min ago, and “View TestFlight”. A wide Apple Ads lane across lower-left shows two enabled and two paused campaigns, total daily budget $92.00 USD, connected demo status, and “Open Apple Ads”; do not show unverified performance totals. A Recent activity lane at lower-right shows three compact, timestamped audit rows and “View activity”. Use a few restrained status dots and one blue highlight, with clear reading priority led by the Release lane.
Style: existing ASC Studio dark theme only: background #0d0f13, surfaces #171a20, main text #f2f4f7, muted #a6adb8, border #2a2f38, blue accent #79adff, success #65c970, warning #eeb245. Flat panels, 7–9px radii, hairline borders, no glass, no gradients, no glow, no oversized KPI numerals, no charts, no decorative illustration.
Text: render labels verbatim and use clean Inter-like system UI typography.
Constraints: preserve familiar button affordances and readable data density; all data is explicitly Demo mode; no invented claims, customers, percentages, performance charts, marketing copy, or unsupported capabilities; no floating cards, bento gimmicks, or mobile frame; no watermark.
